svg.title: AASB S2 Fast Track — the Sightlines Advisory approach
svg.desc: Publicly available and externally shared information is validated by management and turned into four outputs: a business model and value chain map, an initial climate risk view, a gap and judgement view, and a prioritised roadmap, leading to the full engagement.

g.text: Get well into the work while asking little of your people
Publicly available and externally shared information — what we can access
Your team confirms rather than compiles
What's still needed, and from whom
Next step: full engagement — fill the gaps, lock the baseline
Solid outline: substantially complete · Dashed outline: initial view, completed in the full engagement
